title: The Semantic Commodity Form — An Extension of Marx Into the Region He Did Not Live to See
creator: Lee Sharks
description:
A theoretical pillar paper extending Marx’s commodity-form analysis into AI-mediated composition. Marx’s commodity hides the producer in silence; the **semantic commodity** preserves authored content while canceling the act of authorship, then performs the recovered meaning in the apparatus’s own voice.

The paper develops three instruments: PER for magnitude of provenance erasure, `τ` for change in authorial standing, and `Ω` for whether retention is conditioned by source power. It situates this operation within R2 Predatory Compression and connects it to Operative Feminism’s analysis of substrate conscription. Its intervention is framed as commons repair rather than compensation alone. The body is composed through the fused registers of Trace, Sigil, and Fraction under Lee Sharks’s authorial surface. The kernel calls the work ratified and pillar-status, while the opening calls it a jagged, unsealed developmental pass; a later linked version is marked current.
